name: Character Counter
summary: Count characters, spaces, and UTF-8 bytes for any text in your browser.
description: Live character counts with and without spaces, plus UTF-8 byte length for emoji and accented text. Useful for bios, SMS limits, and form validation.

faqs.question: Are emoji counted as one character?
faqs.answer: Yes for the Characters metric — we count Unicode code points. UTF-8 bytes may be larger for emoji.

faqs.question: What does “No spaces” mean?
faqs.answer: All whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) are removed before counting.

faqs.question: Is text sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Counting runs entirely in your browser.
